title: poa annua subsp. varia
intro: Poa annua subsp. varia, commonly known as Annual Bluegrass, is a subspecies of grass that is widely distributed and can be found in various temperate regions. As a plant with multiple uses, it is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Poa annua subsp. varia include its ability to lower fever, reduce pain, and treat respiratory issues, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites.
